SELECT inv.id, inv.product_id, p.name as product_name, inv.purchase_id, pu.purchased, inv.qty as inv_qty
FROM inventory inv
JOIN products p ON inv.product_id = p.id
JOIN purchases pu ON inv.purchase_id = pu.id
ORDER BY p.name, pu.purchased, inv.qty
